target: a lead-list cleaning CLI with tests, built on a real-shaped provider export
prompt: Write me a Python CLI, clean_leads.py, that reads a provider CSV like leads_providerA.csv and writes clean.csv: drop role inboxes (info@, sales@, etc.), drop free-mail addresses, drop companies over a --max-employees limit (default 500), and dedupe by lowercased email. Standard library only. Include tests I can run with python3 -m unittest.

checks.desc: drops the info@, gmail and 2,600-employee rows

rubric: Complete, runnable stdlib script with argparse, error handling and clear messages
Tests cover each rule and pass
Setup and usage steps plus a plain-English explanation of each section
Handles edge cases (missing columns, blank emails, case)
